title: Ontology-Guided Neuro-Symbolic Inference: Grounding Language Models with Mathematical Domain Knowledge
why_relevant: The paper empirically shows that retrieval quality determines whether RAG helps or hurts: high-relevance ontology context improves accuracy while irrelevant retrieved definitions actively degrade performance, directly illustrating distraction and noisy retrieval effects.
why_not_or_caveat: Domain-specific (mathematics with OpenMath ontology) rather than a general robustness study; contribution to robustness is incidental.
